output.content: During the pipeline review, {data_dave} noted that the nightly ingestion jobs pull raw scan lines and stock receipts directly from the source systems without tagging a specific dataset version. When the weekly model retraining begins, the process simply loads the most recent files available in the shared storage bucket. There is no metadata layer recording which snapshot of the point of sale data corresponds to a specific forecast run. The infrastructure team confirmed that the current workflow relies on file timestamps to distinguish between yesterday's data and today's, and no separate registry exists to track historical data states for the distribution centre allocations.
